method: 12 trials: installed unmodified 2.4.2 Goose/OMP (engineering off/on), newly compiled release native candidate, each on 4 identical calibrated tasks. Backend ACP with exact standing and routing desktop prompts; not Electron UI timing. Gemini 3.8 Flash verified per response, primary provider-default effort across all arms; nested OMP high as shipped. Legacy loop, Jev/Axwise off, natural tool choice. Fresh fixtures/profiles; same filesystem confinement and task evaluator. 600s task deadline, 120 combined primary+nested model requests, no retries/replacement trials. Time submission to final response excludes setup and independent evaluation. Parent normal OAuth, child model-only expiring local capability. One sample per arm/task, exploratory.

modelHttpLatency.note: Per-request HTTP durations; overlapping requests can make the sum differ from wall time. Not a measurement of model reasoning alone.

boundary.description: Goose backend and descendants cannot read/write unrelated user, volume or temp trees; app resources read-only; own synthetic workspace/profile/temp writable. Electron remains outside this added filesystem boundary. Network/IPC remain available; this is not complete process or network isolation.

limitations: One observation per task/arm; no general reliability or statistical claim.
600-second time limit and 120 combined outer/nested model requests; every inference attempt retained.
Released 2.4.2 off/on versus release-mode actual native candidate; all four tasks TypeScript. Jev/Axwise off.
Release-off is Orqanix ordinary Goose configuration, not a pristine upstream Goose release.
Released OMP high thinking preserved; primary provider-default effort identical across arms.
ACP backend with version-specific desktop prompts; excludes Electron UI overhead.
Same current production router, Gemini 3.8 Flash verified. Provider/cache load uncontrolled.
Native candidate bundles several changes, so individual causal contributions are not isolated.
